_comment: kb-mcp configuration. Copy to ~/.claude/kb-mcp/config.json (or run: python3 kb_mcp/kb.py config --init) and edit the corpora. Keys starting with _ are comments. Paths take ~ and environment variables. The file found is merged over the built-in defaults, so you may delete every key you do not change.
_corpora: Each corpus is a folder (or a single file) of notes. name: letters, digits, . _ - (it prefixes every result as name:relative/path). path: the folder; a single file is allowed too. include: globs relative to the folder (default: **/*.md, **/*.markdown, **/*.txt). exclude: globs to skip. enabled: false keeps the entry but skips it.

corpora.name: claude-memory
corpora.description: Claude Code auto-memory folders (one per project)

_index_path: The SQLite index. Keep it on a local disk under your home folder, never inside a notes folder, a repository or a cloud-synced folder.
_embedder: Optional semantic lane: an Ollama endpoint serving an embedding model (ollama pull nomic-embed-text). enabled false = lexical search only, no network calls at all. doc_prefix/query_prefix null = the right prefixes for nomic-embed-text, none for other models.
_chunking: Sections become chunks: small neighbours merge up to target_words, sections above max_words split on paragraphs.
_lexical: auto = SQLite FTS5 when the interpreter has it, else a pure-Python BM25 over a postings table.
_search: k results; pool/vec_pool = candidates per lane; rrf_k = reciprocal-rank-fusion constant; vec_weight_min..max = adaptive weight of the vector lane; max_per_file caps hits from one file.
_freshness: The MCP server re-indexes incrementally in the background when the last run is older than this many minutes.
